CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation to content is stated.

COD.rationale: Content (red) and its organization/origin are both explicitly present and separately attributed for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing condition is linked to the content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Identifies represented content (colour) and a spatial attribute for a named referent and current time.

D.rationale: The report separately lists identified content (red) and a distinct organization/origin status for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Specifies how the content instance is organized/derived (origin and represented_time) for the named current referent.
